s0001.literal: Emperor Wenzong, posthumous name Shengming Yuanxiao, taboo name Tugh Temür, was Wuzong's second son and Mingzong's younger brother.
s0001.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong, posthumous name Shengming Yuanxiao, taboo name Tugh Temür, was Wuzong's second son and Mingzong's younger brother.

s0002.literal: His mother was Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng of the Tangut clan.
s0002.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Wenxian Zhaosheng of the Tangut clan.

s0003.literal: In the third year of Dade, Wuzong commanded troops on the northern frontier; the Emperor was born on guihai day in the first month of spring of the eighth year.
s0003.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade, Wuzong commanded troops on the northern frontier; the Emperor was born on guihai day in the first month of spring of the eighth year.

s0004.literal: In the eleventh year, Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation.
s0004.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation.

s0005.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida, Wuzong died and passed the throne to his younger brother Renzong.
s0005.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida, Wuzong died and passed the throne to his younger brother Renzong.

s0006.literal: In the third year of Yanyou, Chancellor Tiemudie'er and others deliberated on installing Shidebala as crown prince; because Mingzong was Wuzong's eldest son, he was sent out and resided in the northern desert.
s0006.idiomatic: In the third year of Yanyou, Chancellor Tiemudie'er and others deliberated on installing Shidebala as crown prince; because Mingzong was Wuzong's eldest son, he was sent out and resided in the northern desert.

s0007.literal: When Shidebala ascended the throne, Tiemudie'er again became chancellor; cherishing private ends and clinging to favor, he provoked strife among kinsmen, and princes and great ministers all felt themselves imperiled.
s0007.idiomatic: When Shidebala ascended the throne, Tiemudie'er again became chancellor; cherishing private ends and clinging to favor, he provoked strife among kinsmen, and princes and great ministers all felt themselves imperiled.

s0008.literal: Fifth month of the first year of Zhizhi, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Yaochu reported that Toghancha'er and others had dealings with princes; thereupon the Emperor was sent out to reside in Hainan.
s0008.idiomatic: Fifth month of the first year of Zhizhi, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Yaochu reported that Toghancha'er and others had dealings with princes; thereupon the Emperor was sent out to reside in Hainan.

s0009.literal: Sixth month of the third year, Shidebala at Shangdu said to Chancellor Baizhu: "We brothers are truly friendly and loving; formerly, because petty men slandered and transmitted false reports, We were made to dwell in a distant place — they should be summoned back at once, and the petty men's crime of sowing discord should be clearly rectified.
s0009.idiomatic: Sixth month of the third year, Shidebala at Shangdu said to Chancellor Baizhu, "We brothers are truly friendly and loving; formerly, because petty men slandered and transmitted false reports, We were made to dwell in a distant place — they should be summoned back at once, and the petty men's crime of sowing discord should be clearly rectified.

s0010.literal: " Before long, Tieshi, Yeshi Temür, and others committed treason; the Prince of Jin thereupon installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.
s0010.idiomatic: " Before long, Tieshi, Yeshi Temür, and others committed treason; the Prince of Jin thereupon installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.

s0011.literal: The Emperor was summoned from Qiong Prefecture in Hainan; reaching Tan Prefecture, he was again ordered to halt.
s0011.idiomatic: The Emperor was summoned from Qiong Prefecture in Hainan; reaching Tan Prefecture, he was again ordered to halt.

s0012.literal: After several months, he returned to the capital.
s0012.idiomatic: After several months, he returned to the capital.

s0013.literal: Tenth month, he was enfeoffed Prince of Huai and granted a gold seal.
s0013.idiomatic: Tenth month, he was enfeoffed Prince of Huai and granted a gold seal.

s0014.literal: First month of the second year, he was again ordered out to reside at Jiankang; Special Sign Office commissioner Yesianier was put in charge of his guard soldiers.
s0014.idiomatic: First month of the second year, he was again ordered out to reside at Jiankang; Special Sign Office commissioner Yesianier was put in charge of his guard soldiers.

s0015.literal: Earlier, after the Prince of Jin had become emperor, he made inner scribe Doresh central secretariat grand councillor, who then became chancellor; crafty and obstinate, acting on his own judgment, calamities and portents repeatedly appeared, while the Emperor and his brother were driven to wander north and south — the hearts of the people turned to them.
s0015.idiomatic: Earlier, after the Prince of Jin had become emperor, he made inner scribe Doresh central secretariat grand councillor, who then became chancellor; crafty and obstinate, acting on his own judgment, calamities and portents repeatedly appeared, while the Emperor and his brother were driven to wander north and south — the hearts of the people turned to them.

s0016.literal: Third month, the imperial procession reached Shangdu; Manu and Kuokochu and others attended as escorts.
s0016.idiomatic: Third month, the imperial procession reached Shangdu; Manu and Kuokochu and others attended as escorts.

s0017.literal: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri remained to guard the capital; Yan Temür also remained at Dadu.
s0017.idiomatic: Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri remained to guard the capital; Yan Temür also remained at Dadu.

s0018.literal: At that time Yesianier secretly went to Shangdu and, with Doresh and others, plotted profit against the Emperor; he then dispatched clan prince registrar Zha Ruhu Chi Yonggutai to transfer the Emperor's residence to Jiangling.
s0018.idiomatic: At that time Yesianier secretly went to Shangdu and, with Doresh and others, plotted profit against the Emperor; he then dispatched clan prince registrar Zha Ruhu Chi Yonggutai to transfer the Emperor's residence to Jiangling.

s0019.literal: Seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu.
s0019.idiomatic: Seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu.

s0020.literal: Doresh together with Prince of Liang Wang Chan and Prince of Liaoning Toqto formed a faction to harm government; everyone was resentful.
s0020.idiomatic: Doresh together with Prince of Liang Wang Chan and Prince of Liaoning Toqto formed a faction to harm government; everyone was resentful.

s0021.literal: At that time Yan Temür in fact held the Privy Council tally and seal at Dadu; he consulted Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and secretly gathered brave men to plot raising righteous action.
s0021.idiomatic: At that time Yan Temür in fact held the Privy Council tally and seal at Dadu; he consulted Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri and secretly gathered brave men to plot raising righteous action.

s0022.literal: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, the hundred officials assembled at Xingsheng Palace; Yan Temür led Alaq Temür, Borjichi, and seventeen others — the troops all bared their blades — and proclaimed to the multitude: "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons, filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; the correct succession of all under Heaven ought to return to them.
s0022.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, the hundred officials assembled at Xingsheng Palace; Yan Temür led Alaq Temür, Borjichi, and 17 others — the troops all bared their blades — and proclaimed to the multitude, "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons, filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; the correct succession of all under Heaven ought to return to them.

s0023.literal: Now you one or two ministers dare to disorder the state's regulations — whoever does not obey shall be beheaded!
s0023.idiomatic: Now you one or two ministers dare to disorder the state's regulations — whoever does not obey shall be beheaded!

s0024.literal: " Thereupon with his own hand he bound grand councillor Ubaidullah and Barqachar; brave men were separately ordered to seize central secretariat left vice chancellor Duodu, associate administrator Wang Shixi, central secretariat deliberator Toqto, Wu Bingdao, supervising censor Temürge, Qiu Shijie, investigating censor Toqan, crown prince household vice director Wang Huan, and others — all were thrown into prison.
s0024.idiomatic: " Thereupon with his own hand he bound grand councillor Ubaidullah and Barqachar; brave men were separately ordered to seize central secretariat left vice chancellor Duodu, associate administrator Wang Shixi, central secretariat deliberator Toqto, Wu Bingdao, supervising censor Temürge, Qiu Shijie, investigating censor Toqan, crown prince household vice director Wang Huan, and others — all were thrown into prison.

s0025.literal: Yan Temür together with Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri jointly guarded the inner court, registered treasury stores, recorded tallies and seals, and summoned the hundred officials into the palace to receive orders.
s0025.idiomatic: Yan Temür together with Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri jointly guarded the inner court, registered treasury stores, recorded tallies and seals, and summoned the hundred officials into the palace to receive orders.

s0026.literal: He immediately dispatched former Henan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Mingli Dong'a and former transmission commissioner Dalimasheri by post relay to welcome the Emperor from Jiangling, secretly conveying his intent to Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran and ordering him to select troops to prepare as escort.
s0026.idiomatic: He immediately dispatched former Henan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Mingli Dong'a and former transmission commissioner Dalimasheri by post relay to welcome the Emperor from Jiangling, secretly conveying his intent to Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran and ordering him to select troops to prepare as escort.

s0027.literal: That day, former Huguang Branch Secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua was made central secretariat left chancellor; crown prince household director Tasihaiya was made central secretariat grand councillor; former Huguang Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Susu was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; former Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate administrator Wang Bulunjatai was made associate privy council administrator; together with central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan, co-signatory privy council administrator Yan Temür, Hanlin academician exemplar Yiliechi, and transmission court commissioner Hanjie they shared in managing state affairs; troops were mobilized to guard strategic passes, garrison troops of the various guards were summoned to encamp at the capital, prefectures and counties were ordered to manufacture weapons, and treasury stores were opened to reward soldiers.
s0027.idiomatic: That day, former Huguang Branch Secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua was made central secretariat left chancellor; crown prince household director Tasihaiya was made central secretariat grand councillor; former Huguang Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Susu was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; former Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate administrator Wang Bulunjatai was made associate privy council administrator; together with central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan, co-signatory privy council administrator Yan Temür, Hanlin academician exemplar Yiliechi, and transmission court commissioner Hanjie they shared in managing state affairs; troops were mobilized to guard strategic passes, garrison troops of the various guards were summoned to encamp at the capital, prefectures and counties were ordered to manufacture weapons, and treasury stores were opened to reward soldiers.

s0028.literal: Yan Temür kept night watch in the forbidden precinct, staying awake until dawn; in one night he might move his lodging twice — no one knew his whereabouts.
s0028.idiomatic: Yan Temür kept night watch in the forbidden precinct, staying awake until dawn; in one night he might move his lodging twice — no one knew his whereabouts.

s0029.literal: On yiwei day, by order of the Prince of Xi'an, paper money was distributed in graded amounts to garrison soldiers guarding the capital, and garrison troops of the various guards were mobilized to hold Juyong Pass and Lu'er Ridge.
s0029.idiomatic: On yiwei day, by order of the Prince of Xi'an, paper money was distributed in graded amounts to garrison soldiers guarding the capital, and garrison troops of the various guards were mobilized to hold Juyong Pass and Lu'er Ridge.

s0030.literal: On bingshen day, left guard commander-in-chief Tolu was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Baima Meadow; Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Taihe Ridge.
s0030.idiomatic: On bingshen day, left guard commander-in-chief Tolu was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Baima Meadow; Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman was ordered to lead troops to encamp at Taihe Ridge.

s0031.literal: On dingyou day, Central Guard troops were dispatched to garrison Qianmin Fort.
s0031.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Central Guard troops were dispatched to garrison Qianmin Fort.

s0032.literal: Saribuhua and others were again dispatched to welcome the Emperor, and Tashi Temür was also ordered to feign being an envoy coming from the south, saying the Emperor had already halted near the suburbs, so the people should not be alarmed or suspicious.
s0032.idiomatic: Saribuhua and others were again dispatched to welcome the Emperor, and Tashi Temür was also ordered to feign being an envoy coming from the south, saying the Emperor had already halted near the suburbs, so the people should not be alarmed or suspicious.

s0033.literal: On wuxu day, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu and Prince Yanbuhua were summoned from Shandong.
s0033.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu and Prince Yanbuhua were summoned from Shandong.

s0034.literal: On jihai day, troops were conscripted in Liaoyang.
s0034.idiomatic: On jihai day, troops were conscripted in Liaoyang.

s0035.literal: Mingli Dong'a reached Bianliang, seized the branch secretariat officials, and threw them all into prison; he also collected the seals of the surveillance commission, the office of commanders of ten-thousands, and prefectures and counties.
s0035.idiomatic: Mingli Dong'a reached Bianliang, seized the branch secretariat officials, and threw them all into prison; he also collected the seals of the surveillance commission, the office of commanders of ten-thousands, and prefectures and counties.

s0036.literal: On gengzi day, Zongren Guard troops were dispatched to reinforce the garrison at Qianmin Fort.
s0036.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zongren Guard troops were dispatched to reinforce the garrison at Qianmin Fort.

s0037.literal: On xinchou day, commander of ten-thousands Cheli Temür was dispatched to lead troops to encamp at Hezhong.
s0037.idiomatic: On xinchou day, commander of ten-thousands Cheli Temür was dispatched to lead troops to encamp at Hezhong.

s0038.literal: On renyin day, Henan Branch Secretariat, because prefectures and counties lacked personnel, temporarily appointed officials to administer affairs in their stead.
s0038.idiomatic: On renyin day, Henan Branch Secretariat, because prefectures and counties lacked personnel, temporarily appointed officials to administer affairs in their stead.

s0039.literal: On guimao day, Yan Temür's younger brother Sadun and son Tangqishi came from Shangdu to submit.
s0039.idiomatic: On guimao day, Yan Temür's younger brother Sadun and son Tangqishi came from Shangdu to submit.

s0040.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat executed grand councillor Qul and right vice chancellor Bietemür.
s0040.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat executed grand councillor Qul and right vice chancellor Bietemür.

s0041.literal: That day, Mingli Dong'a and others reached Jiangling.
s0041.idiomatic: That day, Mingli Dong'a and others reached Jiangling.

s0042.literal: On jiachen day, the Emperor departed Jiangling and dispatched envoys to summon Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, and Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua to assemble.
s0042.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor departed Jiangling and dispatched envoys to summon Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, and Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua to assemble.

s0043.literal: Huguang Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Mahema was seized and sent to the capital; Bieshe replaced him.
s0043.idiomatic: Huguang Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Mahema was seized and sent to the capital; Bieshe replaced him.

s0044.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat disbursed from treasury stores one thousand taels of gold, four thousand taels of silver, and seventy-one thousand ingots of notes, distributing them to officials and commanders.
s0044.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat disbursed from treasury stores 1,000 taels of gold, 4,000 taels of silver, and 71,000 ingots of notes, distributing them to officials and commanders.

s0045.literal: The relevant offices were again ordered to manufacture the imperial carriage, furnishings, and ceremonial regalia.
s0045.idiomatic: The relevant offices were again ordered to manufacture the imperial carriage, furnishings, and ceremonial regalia.

s0046.literal: On yisi day, Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Yesutai'er was dispatched to lead troops to garrison Beilou Pass.
s0046.idiomatic: On yisi day, Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Yesutai'er was dispatched to lead troops to garrison Beilou Pass.

s0047.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat executed its associate administrator Tobutai.
s0047.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat executed its associate administrator Tobutai.

s0048.literal: Shaanxi Branch Surveillance supervising censor Mazhertai and branch secretariat grand councillor Tanmaqi were summoned but did not come.
s0048.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Surveillance supervising censor Mazhertai and branch secretariat grand councillor Tanmaqi were summoned but did not come.

s0049.literal: On bingwu day, Prince Anhun arrived at the capital.
s0049.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Prince Anhun arrived at the capital.

s0050.literal: Former western surveillance censor Lamahaba and others were dispatched to proclaim the intent in Shaanxi.
s0050.idiomatic: Former western surveillance censor Lamahaba and others were dispatched to proclaim the intent in Shaanxi.

s0051.literal: On dingwei day, Sadun guarded Juyong Pass and Tangqishi encamped at Gubeikou Pass.
s0051.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Sadun guarded Juyong Pass and Tangqishi encamped at Gubeikou Pass.

s0052.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast silver tallies to grant soldiers who had merit.
s0052.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to cast silver tallies to grant soldiers who had merit.

s0053.literal: On wushen day, Yan Temür again ordered Naimatai to feign being an envoy coming from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling troops and marching south — those who heard were all pleased.
s0053.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yan Temür again ordered Naimatai to feign being an envoy coming from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling troops and marching south — those who heard were all pleased.

s0054.literal: The Emperor ordered Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran to be made left chancellor of that province.
s0054.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Baran to be made left chancellor of that province.

s0055.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat dispatched former commander of ten-thousands Boluo and others to lead troops to garrison Tong Pass.
s0055.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat dispatched former commander of ten-thousands Boluo and others to lead troops to garrison Tong Pass.

s0056.literal: On jiyou day, princes Manu and Amalatai, clan prince registrar Kuokochu, former Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Mielun, Hanlin attendant reader academician Ulughsibuhua, and Grand Ceremonies Court commissioner Hahaqi — eighteen men in all — jointly plotted to aid Dadu; the plot was discovered and Doresh executed them.
s0056.idiomatic: On jiyou day, princes Manu and Amalatai, clan prince registrar Kuokochu, former Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Mielun, Hanlin attendant reader academician Ulughsibuhua, and Grand Ceremonies Court commissioner Hahaqi — 18 men in all — jointly plotted to aid Dadu; the plot was discovered and Doresh executed them.

s0057.literal: On gengxu day, the Emperor reached Bianliang; Baran and others escorted him north.
s0057.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor reached Bianliang; Baran and others escorted him north.

s0058.literal: Former Hanlin academician exemplar Abuhaiya was made Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor.
s0058.idiomatic: Former Hanlin academician exemplar Abuhaiya was made Henan Branch Secretariat grand councillor.

s0059.literal: The people of Pingluan were conscripted to dig trenches at Qianmin Fort to resist the Liaodong army.
s0059.idiomatic: The people of Pingluan were conscripted to dig trenches at Qianmin Fort to resist the Liaodong army.

s0060.literal: On xinhai day, Yan Temür was made privy council administrator and Yiliechi censor-in-chief.
s0060.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Yan Temür was made privy council administrator and Yiliechi censor-in-chief.

s0061.literal: On renzi day, Asud Guard commander-in-chief Totuo Temür led his army from Shangdu to submit and was immediately ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.
s0061.idiomatic: On renzi day, Asud Guard commander-in-chief Totuo Temür led his army from Shangdu to submit and was immediately ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.

s0062.literal: On guichou day, the seal of the privy council branch office was cast.
s0062.idiomatic: On guichou day, the seal of the privy council branch office was cast.

s0063.literal: That day, Shangdu princes and ministers in power dispatched troops in separate columns to invade the capital region; Prince of Liaoning Toqto, Prince Borad Temür, Grand Preceptor Buqa, left chancellor Doresh, and privy council administrator Temür Toqto remained to guard Shangdu.
s0063.idiomatic: That day, Shangdu princes and ministers in power dispatched troops in separate columns to invade the capital region; Prince of Liaoning Toqto, Prince Borad Temür, Grand Preceptor Buqa, left chancellor Doresh, and privy council administrator Temür Toqto remained to guard Shangdu.

s0064.literal: On jiayin day, Lamahaba and others reached Shaanxi and were all killed.
s0064.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Lamahaba and others reached Shaanxi and were all killed.

s0065.literal: On yimao day, Totuo Temür together with Shangdu princes Shila, grand councillor Naimatai, and household director Qincha fought at Yixing; Qincha was beheaded in battle, Naimatai was captured and sent to the capital and executed, and Shila fled in defeat.
s0065.idiomatic: On yimao day, Totuo Temür together with Shangdu princes Shila, grand councillor Naimatai, and household director Qincha fought at Yixing; Qincha was beheaded in battle, Naimatai was captured and sent to the capital and executed, and Shila fled in defeat.

s0066.literal: On bingchen day, Yan Temür received the imperial carriage and went out to the suburbs to welcome it.
s0066.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Yan Temür received the imperial carriage and went out to the suburbs to welcome it.

s0067.literal: On dingsi day, the Emperor reached the capital and entered to reside in the inner palace.
s0067.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor reached the capital and entered to reside in the inner palace.

s0068.literal: Guich Guard commander-in-chief Tode came from Shangdu, led his army to submit, and was ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.
s0068.idiomatic: Guich Guard commander-in-chief Tode came from Shangdu, led his army to submit, and was ordered to guard Gubeikou Pass.

s0069.literal: On wuwu day, Susu was made central secretariat grand councillor; former associate censor-in-chief Cao Li was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator Zhang Youliang was made central secretariat associate administrator; Henan Branch Secretariat left chancellor Baran was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan was made associate censor-in-chief.
s0069.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Susu was made central secretariat grand councillor; former associate censor-in-chief Cao Li was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator Zhang Youliang was made central secretariat associate administrator; Henan Branch Secretariat left chancellor Baran was made censor-in-chief; central secretariat right vice chancellor Zhao Shiyan was made associate censor-in-chief.

s0070.literal: On jiwei day, Henan commander of ten-thousands Yesutai'er was made associate privy council administrator.
s0070.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Henan commander of ten-thousands Yesutai'er was made associate privy council administrator.

s0071.literal: The Huihui directorate of religious teaching under Haji was abolished.
s0071.idiomatic: The Huihui directorate of religious teaching under Haji was abolished.

s0072.literal: Shangdu Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, grand marshal Buqa, grand councillor Mielun, and censor-in-chief Niudze encamped their armies at Yulin.
s0072.idiomatic: Shangdu Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, grand marshal Buqa, grand councillor Mielun, and censor-in-chief Niudze encamped their armies at Yulin.

s0073.literal: Yixing County was promoted to prefecture.
s0073.idiomatic: Yixing County was promoted to prefecture.

s0074.literal: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Heihan plotted to join Shangdu and was executed at the market; his household was confiscated.
s0074.idiomatic: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Heihan plotted to join Shangdu and was executed at the market; his household was confiscated.

s0075.literal: Ninth month, on gengshen new moon, Yan Temür supervised the army at Juyong Pass and dispatched Sadun with troops to strike Shangdu troops at Yulin, defeated them, pursued them to Huailai, and returned.
s0075.idiomatic: Ninth month, on gengshen new moon, Yan Temür supervised the army at Juyong Pass and dispatched Sadun with troops to strike Shangdu troops at Yulin, defeated them, pursued them to Huailai, and returned.

s0076.literal: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman with troops struck Shangdu princes Mieli Temür and Temochi at Tuoluo Platform, seized them, and brought them back to the capital.
s0076.idiomatic: Longzhen Guard commander-in-chief Ordoman with troops struck Shangdu princes Mieli Temür and Temochi at Tuoluo Platform, seized them, and brought them back to the capital.

s0077.literal: Envoys were dispatched to the army to grant Totuo Temür and others one thousand taels of silver each, to be distributed to meritorious soldiers.
s0077.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to the army to grant Totuo Temür and others 1,000 taels of silver each, to be distributed to meritorious soldiers.

s0078.literal: Silks and cloth were granted to seventy elders of age in the capital.
s0078.idiomatic: Silks and cloth were granted to 70 elders of age in the capital.

s0079.literal: The relevant offices were ordered to requisition horses.
s0079.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to requisition horses.

s0080.literal: Central secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua said: "The Huihui Haha De, from the Zhizhi period onward, borrowed official notes in violation of regulations and separately went to foreign lands, obtaining treasure goods beyond reckoning — by law his property should be confiscated; yet Doresh privately favored his tribesmen and would not allow it; now we request that his household be registered.
s0080.idiomatic: Central secretariat left chancellor Biebuhua said, "The Huihui Haha De, from the Zhizhi period onward, borrowed official notes in violation of regulations and separately went to foreign lands, obtaining treasure goods beyond reckoning — by law his property should be confiscated; yet Doresh privately favored his tribesmen and would not allow it; now we request that his household be registered.

s0082.literal: Yan Temür requested the release of Mahema; approved.
s0082.idiomatic: Yan Temür requested the release of Mahema; approved.

s0083.literal: Shaanxi troops entered Hezhong Prefecture, plundered eighteen thousand ingots of notes from the circulating treasury, and killed associate prefect Buluntu.
s0083.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops entered Hezhong Prefecture, plundered 18,000 ingots of notes from the circulating treasury, and killed associate prefect Buluntu.

s0084.literal: On renxu day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Mountains and Four Rivers.
s0084.idiomatic: On renxu day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Mountains and Four Rivers.

s0085.literal: Susu was ordered to proclaim to the court and countryside: "Formerly under Shizu and the successive sage emperors who ruled, all ordered the Central Secretariat to hold the hundred offices in harness, oversee all government, and manage money and grain, appointments, punishments, and construction — nothing was outside its charge.
s0085.idiomatic: Susu was ordered to proclaim to the court and countryside, "Formerly under Shizu and the successive sage emperors who ruled, all ordered the Central Secretariat to hold the hundred offices in harness, oversee all government, and manage money and grain, appointments, punishments, and construction — nothing was outside its charge.

s0086.literal: From now on, apart from the Privy Council and the Censorate, if any other office or attendant at left or right dares to bypass the Central Secretariat in memorializing on government affairs, it shall be judged violation of regulations; supervising censors shall impeach and report it.
s0086.idiomatic: From now on, apart from the Privy Council and the Censorate, if any other office or attendant at left or right dares to bypass the Central Secretariat in memorializing on government affairs, it shall be judged violation of regulations; supervising censors shall impeach and report it.

s0087.literal: " Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua was made privy council administrator and Yesianier palace provision commissioner.
s0087.idiomatic: " Prince of Gaochang Temür Buqhua was made privy council administrator and Yesianier palace provision commissioner.

s0088.literal: Provisions were supplied to soldiers at Juyong Pass, and notes were granted in graded amounts to Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa and others.
s0088.idiomatic: Provisions were supplied to soldiers at Juyong Pass, and notes were granted in graded amounts to Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa and others.

s0089.literal: Garrison-farming troops of the Five Guards were conscripted to encamp at the capital.
s0089.idiomatic: Garrison-farming troops of the Five Guards were conscripted to encamp at the capital.

s0090.literal: Annam came to court to present local products.
s0090.idiomatic: Annam came to court to present local products.

s0091.literal: Notes were granted in graded amounts to commanders and soldiers from Shangdu who came to submit.
s0091.idiomatic: Notes were granted in graded amounts to commanders and soldiers from Shangdu who came to submit.

s0092.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Henan Branch Secretariat troops are arrayed on garrison duty west of the Huai River, not far from Tong Pass and Hezhong; Huguang Branch Secretariat troops — only the two commands of ten-thousands at Pingyang and Baoding are called elite — we request that ten thousand garrison troops from Qi and Huang be mobilized together with the two commands of ten-thousands, making thirty thousand, and that Huguang associate administrator Zheng Angxiao and commander of ten-thousands Totuo Temür lead them, encamping along the Yellow River for convenient dispatch.
s0092.idiomatic: Privy Council officials said, "Henan Branch Secretariat troops are arrayed on garrison duty west of the Huai River, not far from Tong Pass and Hezhong; Huguang Branch Secretariat troops — only the two commands of ten-thousands at Pingyang and Baoding are called elite — we request that 10,000 garrison troops from Qi and Huang be mobilized together with the two commands of ten-thousands, making 30,000, and that Huguang associate administrator Zheng Angxiao and commander of ten-thousands Totuo Temür lead them, encamping along the Yellow River for convenient dispatch.

s0094.literal: Yan Temür was summoned to audience at court.
s0094.idiomatic: Yan Temür was summoned to audience at court.

s0095.literal: Shangdu princes Yesi Temür and grand councillor Tuman De'er entered Qianmin Fort with troops from Liaodong; princes Barama and Yesi Temür entered Guan Prefecture with their subordinate troops, killing and plundering officials and people.
s0095.idiomatic: Shangdu princes Yesi Temür and grand councillor Tuman De'er entered Qianmin Fort with troops from Liaodong; princes Barama and Yesi Temür entered Guan Prefecture with their subordinate troops, killing and plundering officials and people.

s0096.literal: On bingyin day, weapons were ordered manufactured — sixty thousand sets in the three provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang, and forty thousand sets in the inner prefectures.
s0096.idiomatic: On bingyin day, weapons were ordered manufactured — 60,000 sets in the three provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang, and 40,000 sets in the inner prefectures.

s0097.literal: On dingmao day, Yan Temür led the princes and great ministers to prostrate themselves at the palace gate and request early rectification of the Great Foundation to settle all under Heaven; the Emperor firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the northern desert — how dare I disorder Heaven's order?
s0097.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yan Temür led the princes and great ministers to prostrate themselves at the palace gate and request early rectification of the Great Foundation to settle all under Heaven; the Emperor firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the northern desert — how dare I disorder Heaven's order?

s0098.literal: " Yan Temür said: "The moment when hearts turn toward or away from one is a gap that admits no delay — once lost, there will be no time to regret.
s0098.idiomatic: " Yan Temür said, "The moment when hearts turn toward or away from one is a gap that admits no delay — once lost, there will be no time to regret.

s0099.literal: " The Emperor said: "If it cannot be avoided, my intent must first be made clear and shown to all under Heaven — only then may it be done.
s0099.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "If it cannot be avoided, my intent must first be made clear and shown to all under Heaven — only then may it be done.

s0100.literal: " Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu, and others were each granted fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and thirty bolts of silks.
s0100.idiomatic: " Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri, Prince of Zhennan Temür Buqa, Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua, Prince of Xuanjing Bainu, and others were each granted 50 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 30 bolts of silks.
